verdict.rationale: The Directory Sync docs say directory updates can be delivered via webhooks or retrieved through the Events API, so webhook subscription exists at least for directory changes. The evidence covers only that one product area and gives no detail on how subscriptions work. Missing for 10: webhook endpoint configuration and subscription docs, a catalog of event types beyond Directory Sync (e.g. auth or user-management events), signature verification and retry/delivery guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
